title: Customer discounts are still frozen on the work order and come last
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Make sure customer B has a 5% discount in Fees & Discounts, set before work order 1 was made.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and no labor amount on line 1.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Change customer B's discount to 10% in Fees & Discounts.
  2. Open work order 1.
  3. Click Add Part under line 1.
  4. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  5. Type 1 in Qty.
  6. Pick category A in Category.
  7. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Click the Stats tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer B's discount reads 10%.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 3:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 4:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 5:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 6:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 7:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 8:

  • The part reads $135.00 ($100.00 × 1.35), with no discount in the line price.

Step 9:

  • Stats take the frozen 5% off at the end: $135.00 × 0.05 = $6.75; $135.00 − $6.75 = $128.25.
  • The new 10% does not apply to work order 1.
